uncertainties: s16-09, s16-13, s28-01, s38-01: dot is very close to the vav head; judged detached from a thin visible gap.
s16-08, s16-12, s18-01, s18-02: small or faint dots on worn print; judged present but less certain.
s20-03: judged absent; at this resolution a very faint holam fused into the vav head can't be fully ruled out.
observations: 46 of 47 crops show a detached holam dot above the he/vav junction, slightly over the vav head.
s20-03 is the only one without a holam, and its pointing also differs (Elohim-type reading).
s20-02, s20-04 and s20-06 have extra marks above the line (accents or ink from the line above), which were not counted as holam.
Each crop was judged on its own; no result was inferred from other crops.
